cohort: The study cohort comprised 75 elderly primiparous women diagnosed with postpartum depression (divided into intervention and control groups) and 80 elderly primiparous women without depression, all from the First Hospital of Nanchang.
finding: Mindfulness-based psychological intervention significantly improved psychological well-being and sleep quality in elderly primiparas with postpartum depression, while advanced maternal age, higher education level, pregnancy complications, and lower newborn Apgar score were identified as independent risk factors for postpartum depression.
